titleEn: DNA study of ancient cranes suggests we need to rethink how many species have gone extinct
titleZh: 古鹤 DNA 研究：我们可能需要重新估计灭绝物种的数量
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: The human-driven extinction crisis that we are undoubtedly experiencing today is one of the great challenges of our age.
paragraphs.zh: 毫无疑问，我们今天正在经历的人类灭绝危机是我们这个时代的重大挑战之一。

paragraphs.en: Human-driven extinctions have been going on in some form for thousands of years. And birds have been among the hardest hit, with claims that they have experienced higher levels of extinction than is often realised.
paragraphs.zh: 人类的灭绝已经以某种形式持续了数千年，鸟类受到的打击最为严重，据称它们经历的灭绝程度比人们通常意识到的要高。

paragraphs.en: However, it might be that some of these claimed extinctions require re-examination. Our recent study used ancient DNA analyses to resolve the identity of a large crane known from remains dating from possibly 20,000 years ago or more, until about 1,000 years ago. This crane was classified 150 years ago as a distinct species known as Grus primigenia.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些所谓的排除可能需要重新检查。我们最近的研究使用古代DNA分析来确定一种大型起重机的身份，这种大型起重机的遗骸可以追溯到20，000年前或更早，直到大约1，000年前。这种起重机在150年前被归类为一种独特的物种，称为Grus gradgenia。

paragraphs.en: There is a longstanding controversy over whether the classification of this extinct continental bird is valid and reliable. This giant, primeval crane was named in the 19th century by the French biologist Alphonse Milne-Edwards, from bone fragments found in caves in the south of France.
paragraphs.zh: 关于这种已灭绝的大陆鸟类的分类是否有效和可靠，长期存在争议。这种巨大的原始起重机是在19世纪由法国生物学家Alphonse Milne-Edwards根据在法国南部洞穴中发现的骨头碎片命名的。

paragraphs.en: These first bones attributed to Grus primigenia were dated to the end of the last ice age. Since then, many other remains of cranes have been attributed to the extinct species.
paragraphs.zh: 这些最早的骨骼被认为是灰鹤的，它们的年代可以追溯到最后一个冰河时代的末期。从那时起，许多其他的鹤的遗骸被认为是这种灭绝的物种。

paragraphs.en: Other ideas about the identity of these large cranes have been proposed over the years since their first description. Some authors suggested that they represented large living species such as the sarus crane Antigone antigone, found today in Asia and associated with monsoon climates.
paragraphs.zh: 自首次描述以来，关于这些大型鹤的身份，多年来一直有人提出其他想法。一些作者认为，它们代表了大型物种，如今天在亚洲发现的与季风气候有关的大型起重机antigone。

paragraphs.en: Alternatively, some thought they might be Siberian crane Leucogeranus leucogeranus, which breed in the tundra of eastern Siberia. However, the suggestion that they were simply larger versions of the common crane (Grus grus), still living in Europe today, has regularly been proposed.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种观点认为它们可能是西伯利亚起重机Leucogeranus leucogeranus，在西伯利亚东部的冻土地带繁殖。然而，经常有人提出，它们只是今天仍生活在欧洲的普通起重机（Grus grus）的大型版本。

paragraphs.en: To investigate the identity of the primeval crane we sampled 18 crane bones from England, Wales, France, Germany and the Balearic Islands and included specimens of a variety of sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了调查原始起重机的身份，我们从英格兰、威尔士、法国、德国和巴利阿里群岛采集了18块起重机骨骼样本，其中包括各种大小的标本。

paragraphs.en: The results of the analysis, done at the Centre for Palaeogenetics in Stockholm, Sweden, strongly suggest that they all belonged to the same species, the living common crane, and that the other proposed identities could be excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 在瑞典斯德哥尔摩的古遗传学中心进行的分析结果强烈表明，它们都属于同一物种，即现存的普通起重机，其他提出的身份可以排除。

paragraphs.en: Why so many species?
paragraphs.zh: 为什么有这么多物种？

paragraphs.en: The next stage of the analysis was to determine why these large cranes had been given distinct species status. One of the justifications for their identification as a separate species was that there appeared to be two species in the past in Europe. The smaller individuals were thought to belong to the smaller common crane and larger ones were considered to be members of the extinct crane species.
paragraphs.zh: 分析的下一个阶段是确定为什么这些大型鹤被赋予不同的物种地位。将它们确定为单独物种的理由之一是，过去在欧洲似乎有两个物种。较小的个体被认为属于较小的普通起重机，而较大的个体被认为是灭绝的起重机物种的成员。

paragraphs.en: However, even before our findings were published, there was a clue that this was a misreading of the situation. A survey of the modern common crane revealed that male birds exceed the size of females; they are highly sexually “dimorphic” – where males and females of a species exhibit significant physical differences.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，甚至在我们的研究结果发表之前，就有一个线索表明，这是对形势的误读。对现代普通起重机的调查显示，雄性鸟类的体型超过雌性;它们在性别上高度“二态化”--一个物种的雄性和雌性表现出明显的身体差异。

paragraphs.en: This was important because when the ancient cranes were compared to the modern birds there appeared to be very few cranes in the past that were the size of modern female birds.
paragraphs.zh: 这一点很重要，因为当古代鹤与现代鸟类相比时，过去似乎很少有鹤的大小与现代雌鸟相同。

paragraphs.en: Instead, there were cranes that were the size of modern males and ones that were even larger. These larger birds have been attributed to the extinct species of crane. This appeared to suggest that the common crane had shrunk in size over time.
paragraphs.zh: 取而代之的是与现代雄性鹤一样大的鹤和更大的鹤。这些更大的鸟被认为是灭绝的起重机。这似乎表明普通的起重机随着时间的推移体型缩小了。

paragraphs.en: Using a molecular genetic methodology, we uncovered the sexes of the crane specimens used in this study to determine if the larger birds were dominantly males and the ones that conformed to the size of modern males included females. The result was clear: size change and sexual dimorphism had erroneously implied that two separate species had lived in Europe during the last 20,000 years.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用分子遗传学方法，对研究中使用的起重机标本进行了性别鉴定，以确定较大的鸟类是否以雄性为主，而符合现代雄性体型的鸟类是否包括雌性。结果很明显：体型变化和两性异形错误地暗示了过去2万年来欧洲生活着两个不同的物种。

paragraphs.en: Local extinction
paragraphs.zh: 当地灭绝

paragraphs.en: The latest individuals that exceeded the modern common crane in size are from Lincolnshire in England. They had been excavated from an Anglo-Saxon archaeological site at Flixborough, where there was evidence that high-status people may have feasted on them.
paragraphs.zh: 最新发现的体型超过现代普通起重机的个体来自英格兰林肯郡，它们是在弗利克斯伯勒的盎格鲁-撒克逊考古遗址中被挖掘出来的，有证据表明，那里的上层人士可能曾享用过它们。

paragraphs.en: This indicates that some time during the approximately 1,000 years since the Lincolnshire finds, the common crane shrank in size. Why this occurred is unclear, although the fact that the species disappeared from Britain and many parts of Europe since that time is probably relevant. However, the birds returned to the UK of their own accord during the 1970s.
paragraphs.zh: 这表明，在林肯郡发现后的大约1,000年里，普通起重机的体积缩小了。为什么会发生这种情况尚不清楚，尽管从那时起，该物种从英国和欧洲许多地区消失的事实可能与此有关。然而，这些鸟类在20世纪70年代自行雅阁返回英国。

paragraphs.en: Wetland drainage and hunting have been blamed for the British local extinction about 400 years ago. The former is perhaps the most likely cause of the size decrease, as it might be symptomatic of habitat degradation across the birds’ range.
paragraphs.zh: 大约400年前，湿地排水和狩猎被认为是英国局部物种灭绝的原因。前者也许是规模缩小的最可能原因，因为它可能是整个鸟类栖息地退化的症状。

paragraphs.en: The implications of this detailed analysis of the longest-standing controversy in recent avian extinction may be that caution needs to be exercised when reviews of historic extinctions are made.
paragraphs.zh: 对最近鸟类灭绝中存在时间最长的争议进行详细分析的意义可能是，在审查历史性灭绝时需要谨慎行事。

paragraphs.en: If birds are not identified from living individuals, like the great auk was, and are instead named based on the sizes of bones from the past, molecular analyses are probably needed to confirm that they are indeed separate species.
paragraphs.zh: 如果鸟类不是像大海雀那样从活着的个体中识别出来，而是根据过去骨骼的大小来命名，那么可能需要分子分析来确认它们确实是独立的物种。

paragraphs.en: Many extinct animals have been declared as species based on such characteristics. This suggests that at least some are likely to be differently sized individuals of the same species – not a separate one.
paragraphs.zh: 许多灭绝的动物都是根据这些特征被宣布为物种的，这表明至少有一些可能是同一物种中不同大小的个体，而不是一个单独的物种。
